title: Event
description: A dated history milestone (kind history, status V/P/S/U per R07) or industry event (kind industry, evidence grade per R09), with date precision, citation (DOI or URL) and access date.

organizations_verified.description: False when the institution is standard attribution not re-checked against the byline (R07 '*').

source_ref.description: Source id in the research note (e.g. R09 S19).

status.description: History: V = publication or announcement confirmed by Crossref or a primary page (bibliographic record verified at the source; the YAML source uses V, the published API writes it as rec so it is not read as the site-wide V = vendor datasheet); P = publication confirmed, LN link or a detail from a secondary source; S = secondary source read (trade press, retrospective, catalog); derived = count or calculation from cited data (method in notes); U = unverified (snippet-only or unchecked), excluded from default endpoints.

grade.description: Industry evidence grade(s) per R09 sec. 0: F fact (primary read), V vendor claim, T trade press read, C snippet only, LG low grade, E estimate, S speculation. Combined grades joined by '/'.

verified.description: Generated: false for history status U and for industry events graded only C, LG, E or S.
